lead.headline: Iran sets six conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz
lead.dek: Tehran's terms reach past the June memorandum even as an Oman corridor deal nears
body: Iran's Supreme National Security Council said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the United States "corrects its behavior," setting out six conditions in a statement carried by Iranian state media on Saturday.

Council secretary Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, a Revolutionary Guard commander, demanded an end to U.S. threats, a permanent halt to attacks on Iran and its allies, a lifting of the naval blockade, compensation for two wars, an end to sanctions and the release of frozen assets.

The list goes beyond the June 17 memorandum, recasting phased steps as preconditions. Iran and Oman have nearly settled a corridor plan routing inbound traffic through Iranian waters and outbound through Omani waters for 60 days. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called it very close.

art.caption: Small craft lie at anchor on flat water below the bare coastal mountains at the mouth of the strait.
art.credit: Sketched from an Al Jazeera photograph

briefs.headline: Senate passes Russia and Iran sanctions bill 86-11
briefs.summary: It sanctions top Russian officials, extends Iran sanctions and allows tariffs up to 100% on major buyers of Russian energy. It must clear the House next.

briefs.headline: New Mexico judge orders Meta to pay $567M over child harms
briefs.summary: The judge also ordered safeguards for minors, among them a 90-hour monthly cap and hidden like counts. Meta said it will appeal.

briefs.headline: Salmonella tied to jalapenos sickens 345 in 27 states
briefs.summary: The USDA flagged 18 recalled meat and poultry products Saturday and reported 36 hospitalizations.

briefs.headline: China moves 500,000 as Typhoon Dolphin nears landfall
briefs.summary: More than 1,600 flights were cancelled, most at Shanghai's airports, under a red alert. Parts of Zhejiang could take 500mm of rain.

briefs.headline: British Columbia declares emergency as 20,000 flee fires
briefs.summary: Premier David Eby acted Saturday with more than 100 fires burning, nearly half out of control. Summerland and Peachland were emptied.

briefs.headline: Spain imposes border checks on Italy in Ceuta migration row
briefs.summary: Controls began at midnight Saturday and run to Sept. 7, answering Italy's own.

briefs.headline: 25,000 Hope Scholarship students get first payments Aug. 13
briefs.summary: The award is $5,435.62 for 2026-27 and 1,485 providers are enrolled. Treasurer Larry Pack said the money is going out early.

briefs.headline: WVU Medicine moves to acquire a Pennsylvania hospital
briefs.summary: It would take on Fulton County Medical Center in McConnellsburg, 21 beds and 415 employees, and invest up to $17M over seven years.

regional.item: A train struck a vehicle at a Buffalo crossing Saturday afternoon, injuring one person.

fishing.line: Sound highs 5:24 a.m. and 6:09 p.m.; water 79.2F at Wrightsville Beach, 25 miles down the coast.

briefs.headline: Chelsea beats AC Milan 3-0 in Jakarta friendly
briefs.summary: Joao Pedro glanced in a Moises Caicedo corner in first-half stoppage time and scored again on 46 minutes; Caicedo made it three on 50.

briefs.headline: Women's Professional Baseball League opens first season
briefs.summary: Four teams debuted Saturday before a sold-out crowd in Springfield, Illinois. The six-week season runs at one central ballpark.

briefs.headline: Meteorite that hit a New Jersey roof holds amino acids
briefs.summary: The Hillsborough stone, a rare CM1/2 chondrite, carries salts left by brines on its parent asteroid, per Science Advances.

briefs.headline: Telescope resolves 20-kilometer whirlpools on the Sun
briefs.summary: The Inouye Solar Telescope caught plasma vortices at granule edges that may twist magnetic field lines, researchers report in Nature.

briefs.headline: Heart benefit lands nearer 560 minutes a week than 150
briefs.summary: Among 17,088 UK Biobank participants followed 7.8 years, 150 minutes cut cardiovascular risk 8% to 9%; 560 to 610 cut it over 30%.
